title: Validate Skill input JSON against manifest schema
goal: Validate manifest input JSON centrally before any Skill executor runs, so custom executors cannot receive malformed or schema-invalid inputs.
context: SkillRuntime passes inputJSON directly to custom registered executors. Built-in executors perform their own checks, but the runtime does not enforce SchemaDocument.rawJSON for custom executors, allowing required-field/type/additional-property violations to reach capability code.
forbidden_changes: Do not call an executor before input validation succeeds.
Do not silently ignore malformed schema JSON or unsupported validation keywords.
Do not change policy/approval semantics or output verification.
Do not claim full JSON Schema support beyond the explicitly supported subset.
acceptance_criteria: Every manifest-backed Skill execution validates inputJSON before executor invocation.
Malformed input JSON or malformed schema fails closed with malformedSkill.
Supported type/required/properties/additionalProperties/items/enum/const and simple bounds are enforced; unsupported schema keywords fail closed.
Regression proves invalid input and malformed schema never invoke the custom executor.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: Keep validation centralized before executor invocation, reject malformed schemas/inputs, and add a custom executor counter proving no side effects occur on validation failure.
